marketing_wrapper: Heavy. All six use a pale sky-blue gradient backdrop with floating 3D rock shards and a two-weight headline (regular plus bold). The device frame fades out at the bottom into the backdrop, so each screen is cropped to its top 60-70%. 01 adds a 4.9-star ratings badge, 02 the ADA 2025 Social Impact laurel. 05 drops the frame entirely: the focus-timer UI (LCD clock, stepper, Start button) is composited onto a rocky landscape, so UI and art are hard to separate there.

typography.display: System SF Pro: bold/semibold for metrics ('1h 23m', '2h 56m'), bold white headlines on the block screen. Custom 'Opal' wordmark top-left. 05 uses a seven-segment LCD numeral face for the focus timer.
typography.numerals: SF semibold proportional for scores and durations, tinted ice blue; seven-segment LCD digits on the timer; small all-caps labels above stats.
typography.weights: Semibold/bold for values and titles, regular grey for secondary copy.
typography.case_and_tracking: Small all-caps tracked labels ('SCORE', 'SCREEN TIME', 'CULPRITS', 'LESS THAN USUAL'); sentence case elsewhere.

palette.accent_strategy: One accent: an ice/opal blue used for metric values, the progress ring glow, icon strokes and button rims. Third-party app icons (Instagram, TikTok, Facebook) supply the only other colour, plus a small orange flame count.
palette.source: palette.json 01-06: dark UI greys #08080a, #181b1e, #30363d; light blue clusters #93c0d8-#cae3f4 are partly the marketing backdrop and partly the accent, separated visually; #9fe8f5 ice highlight is a visual estimate

shape.radius_language: large: cards about 24-28 pt, pill buttons ('Start Timer', 'Learn Bedtime Tips', 'Block Apps No'), circular stepper and avatar buttons, rounded-rect locked app tiles
shape.concentric: yes: inner app tiles and buttons sit concentrically inside rounded glass cards
shape.borders_shadows: Bright hairline rims on glass cards and buttons (light-catching edges); glow around the progress ring; blurred backdrop beneath cards.
shape.materials: Frosted dark glass cards with lit edges, rendered 3D gem on a stone plinth in a cave scene, photo-backed rule cards, starfield specks.

liquid_glass_visible: yes, bespoke: rim-lit translucent cards and pill buttons over blurred imagery on Insights (04), Rules (06) and the timer (05); custom-drawn rather than the system tab bar
density: low-medium: a hero gem scene, a three-stat row, then one card per section; rule cards in a 2-column grid
layout: Home: 'Opal' wordmark top-left, flame streak count and avatar top-right; full-bleed 3D scene with the current gem on a plinth; a three-column stat row (Score, Screen Time, Culprits as app icons); then a 'My Apps' card with active rules and locked app tiles. Apps screen: large title, a row of locked app icons with 'Unblock', then 'Rules' as photo cards in a 2-column grid. Block screen: blurred app icon, bold headline, a wry two-line subtitle.
navigation: No tab bar visible in any image. Large-title headers ('Apps'), section links with chevrons ('My Apps >', 'Rules >', 'Insights >'). Custom chrome throughout.
imagery_and_icons: 3D rendered gem and rock environments, stylised photos on rule cards, a classical-bust avatar, SF Symbols-style line icons (bed, shield, calendar, arrow) in ice blue, real third-party app icons.
signature_visual_move: Home is a dim cave diorama with a glowing iridescent opal on a stone plinth as the score object, and every card is dark frosted glass with an ice-lit rim.

direction_fit.why: The 3D gem as an earned collectible is the governing asset (Toy), and the near-black base with soft ice-blue glows and glass cards confirms the productivity record's 'Glow-Dark Wellness' description. The text record's 'dark gradient' doubt is resolved: the UI is near-black with a dark grey cave scene, not a coloured gradient.

notes: The pale blue backdrop dominates palette.json but is wrapper only; the app itself is dark. The ice-blue glow on the ring and lit rims reads as a 'glow' tell in isolation, but it is used with one accent and a coherent stone/gem world, so it is authored rather than template. Block-screen copy ('Past you was right.') matches the cheeky voice in the text record.
